author: Glesmon
body: I got banned for fly hacking by SnowSX3 unexpectedly and I wasn't fly hacking (Reply if you need more info, I just needed to get the basic idea on website).

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello. 

Due to the fact evidence cannot be provided with your ban, I have decided to appeal your infraction. In the event that you were hacking, please do not make another mistake like this in the future. 

You will be appealed shortly. 

With that, I welcome you back to the server. 

Sincerely,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator.
